steps.content: [Tuco - Street]
Hella dashes towards the square, her heart pounding as if it's about to leap out of her chest.

steps.speaker: Hella
steps.content: There's only one car and it can fit at most five, no, eight people...?

steps.speaker: Hella
steps.content: I need to get them out... What do I do... What do I do!?
In her head, plans pop up and then get ruled out one after another.
The square finally comes into view. She sees the figure in the center...
[Tuco - Square]

steps.speaker: Timmy
steps.content: Everyone! Follow me back inside!
Timmy calls out to the townsfolk, guiding them towards the town hall.

steps.speaker: Timmy
steps.content: Don't worry, I'll be guarding the door. If any monsters come in, I'll protect you!

steps.speaker: Timmy
steps.content: Maggie and Korryn are both outside. We'll be fine!
He yells with all his might, but his voice gets drowned out by the fierce wind.
Mira kneels on the sand-covered ground, prying open a sharp trap with her hands. Her face no longer bears her trademark smile.

steps.speaker: Mira
steps.content: There's a hole in the northern wall that we built earlier. If it's not patched up, something might get in.

steps.speaker: Mira
steps.content: Korryn has already gone to the main gate. She probably can't handle it alone. We need to seal the side gate first and then go help!

steps.speaker: Maggie
steps.content: Understood! I'll go right away.
Wright pants from all the running. His throat is hoarse, and he can't stop coughing. He finally staggers to a stop in front of the town hall.

steps.speaker: Wright
steps.content: (Cough) ...Mira! I'll go with you!

steps.speaker: Timmy
steps.content: Mr. Wright! No, you can't go, not when you're this sick...

steps.speaker: Wright
steps.content: I'm fine! You guys go back! It's just a cough. It's not like I have a broken leg! I can still fight those monsters!

steps.speaker: Wright
steps.content: Timmy, let go of me... ouch!
A strong force pushes both of them through the door. Hella blocks the door and uses a wooden pole to bar the town hall's entrance.

steps.speaker: Hella
steps.content: If you're sick, don't try to be tough!

steps.speaker: Hella
steps.content: I won't let any sickly folks or liars be the hero! I'm gonna go fight this sandstorm! Just wait for my victorious return!
